Hundad was a man of the House of Haleth in the First Age. His father was Hundar, and his son was Hardang, who became Chieftain of Brethil during the later life of Húrin Thalion.

page.overview:
Who is Hundad?

Hundad was a man of the House of Haleth in the First Age. His father was Hundar, and his son was Hardang, who became Chieftain of Brethil during the later life of Húrin Thalion.
